Title: Word / Character Counter
Description: Count words, characters, lines, paragraphs, and sentences. Get reading and speaking time estimates for your text.
InputPlaceholder: Type or paste your text here to count words, characters, and more...
Seo_Introduction: The Word / Character Counter is a privacy-first online tool designed for writers, students, and developers. All processing happens locally in your browser, ensuring your text never leaves your device. Get instant statistics including word count, character count, lines, paragraphs, sentences, and estimated reading and speaking times.
Seo_DetailedDescription:
This comprehensive text analysis tool provides detailed statistics for any text you input. Built with modern web technologies, it delivers instant results directly in your browser without any server-side processing.

The tool counts words, characters (with and without spaces), lines, paragraphs, and sentences. It also calculates estimated reading time (based on 200 words per minute) and speaking time (based on 130 words per minute), making it perfect for preparing speeches, presentations, and articles.
Seo_Examples:
**Example 1**: Paste your essay or article to get the exact word count and reading time for academic requirements or blog posts.

**Example 2**: Check the character count for social media posts to ensure they fit within platform limits (like Twitter or SMS).

**Example 3**: Prepare a speech by checking the speaking time estimate to ensure it fits within your allotted time slot.
Seo_HowToSteps:
### Step 1: Enter Your Text
Type or paste your text into the input field. The statistics will update automatically as you type.

### Step 2: Review Statistics
View the real-time statistics displayed on the right panel, including word count, character count, lines, paragraphs, and sentences.

### Step 3: Check Time Estimates
Look at the estimated reading and speaking times to plan your content appropriately.
Seo_Tips:
- All processing happens in your browser for maximum privacy
- No data is sent to any server
- Use the Paste button to quickly insert text from your clipboard
- Use the Copy button to copy your text back to the clipboard
- The tool works offline after the initial page load
